page.layout: One page of text in a single column; running head at top with page number at right; below the text a rule, then a footnote in smaller italic type set in two columns (left and right); signature word "Johannes" at lower right as a catchword.

main_text.p: shine your light before men, as they may see your workes, and glorifie the father that is in heaven. No tittle nor letter of the law shall pass over, till all things be done. Item quod hanc lectionem eundem docuerit (ex Matth. V. 1.) 4 Jesus seeing his people: as he went up to a hill, was set; and his disciples came to him: he opened his mouth, and taught them, saying: Blessed be the poore men in spirite; for the kingdome of heaven is theirs. Blessed be mild men: for they shall welde the earth. Quinquies ad Agneten accesslit Mordenus ut priorem, bis ut alteram, discerct lectionem: & utramque ipsa Agnes recitare jussa est coram sex Episcopis; qui severe eidem interdixerunt, ne ullos omnino in posterum, ac liberos suos praesertim, lectiones istas edoceret. [Ex Registr. Longland, fol. 11.]
Henricus Miller & Joannes Phips, à Thomâ Holmes detecti, ut Scripturarum periti.

Joannes Butler faber lignarius, Richardus Butler, Wilhelmus King de Uxbridge, quòd in aedibus Durdanti de Ivencourt totâ nocte Scripturæ codicem legissent. Item Durdantus senex, quòd inter prandendum (puero, qui astiterat, abscedere jussło) liberis suis eorumque uxoribus loca quaedam ex Epistolis Paulinis & Evangeliis recitâssent. Item Jo. Butler à proprio fratre accusatus est; quod librum quendam Scripturæ ipsi legisset, & ut eidem auscultaret, persuasisset.

Durdantus prope Stanes, Durdantus senex, Isabella T. Hardingi uxor, Hartop de Windsor, Joanna Barret uxor Joannis Barret Londinensis, Henricus Miller, Stilmanus sartor, accusati omnes, quòd ad nuptias filiæ Durdanti convenientes in horreo, Epistolam quandam D. Pauli audivissent: cujus lectionem cùm reliqui, tum praecipuè Durdantus, approbârint & commendârint.

Johannes Barret aurifaber Londinensis; quòd domi suæ, uxore & ancillâ praesentibus, Epistolam S. Jacobi (quam cum aliis multis tenebat memoriter) recitâsset. Item Joanna uxor, quòd Joanni Scrivener Evangelium secundum Matthæum & Marcum mutuò commodâsset, quem librum ipse Episcopo Smitho tradidit. Item

4 Videns autem Jesus turbas suas, ascendit in montem; & cum sedisset, accesserunt ad eum discipuli ejus; & aperiens os suum, docebat eos, dicens: Beati pauperes spiritu; quoniam ipsorum est regnum cœlorum. Beati mites; quoniam ipsi possidebunt terram.

page.notes: The running head is in italic/roman mixed type; the footnote is set in two columns of small italic type and is transcribed as one note. Some words in the footnote and the margin-free body are doubtful due to the scan's blur, notably "welde" (possibly "weld") and "prandendum"; the Latin in the first paragraph is partly in Roman type and partly black letter, rendered as roman. No marginal notes are present.
